title: 2009 ICF Canoe Sprint World Championships
note: Dartmouth (Halifax), 13-16 Aug 2009. Races, lanes and start times from the ICF archive results book (each race header prints day + start to the minute, scheduled, HH:MM:00); race numbers from the book's own Race Schedule pages. TEAM = flag image identified through the book's own Countries legend (same image -> country name -> NOC), logged per boat. Full names from the canoeresults.eu printout (cfly.ca, approved for this event only, MAINTAINER_ANSWERS_2026-10-19c Q71) for the races it lists (finals A); elsewhere the book prints surnames only and seats bind only on a unique same-nation same-gender surname. Pre-2013: binds bound_by_name_unconfirmed (Q44). DIFFERENCE not written.
